cohort: 77 pregnant women who underwent open fetal surgery for myelomeningocele between 24 and 27 weeks of gestation
finding: A uterine scar thickness of 3.0 mm or less after open fetal surgery for myelomeningocele was identified as a cut-off point associated with an increased risk of uterine rupture.
gest_age: 24-27 weeks at surgery, 34.3 ± 1.2 weeks at delivery
